newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Thai banks to recover - Asset Plus.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Thai banks to recover - Asset Plus.

text.p: Thai bank shares prices should bounce back once interest rates fall and and investors are confident that the central bank has successfully beaten back attacks on the baht, Asset Plus Securities said on Monday.

"Once it becomes clear to investors that the Bank of Thailand can successfully defend the baht and interest rates can fall, we expect bank share prices to bounce due to cheap valuations and the prospect that the recovery process can begin," it said in a new report.
